description: Manejo residuos peligrosos Palmira is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Alcaldía de Palmira, Valle del Cauca. Visitas de manejo de residuos peligrosos en el municipio de Palmira en la vigencia. Tuvo actualización hasta año el año 2021. No se continuara actualizando. Coverage: Alcaldía de Palmira, Valle del Cauca. The portal files it under the publisher Alcaldía de Palmira, Valle del Cauca. Its tags are residuos peligrosos, alcaldía de palmira, palmira. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Salud y Protección Social. The portal shows 2023-09-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
